occupancy.desktopOnly: Occupancy diagnostics require the desktop native runtime.
occupancy.volumeRequired: Choose a volume mount point first.
occupancy.hint: File diagnostics match only the selected file. Volume diagnostics match fixed process-reference coverage by mount identity. macOS uses fixed-argument lsof and Linux matches visible /proc; results include coverage, truncation, and identity revalidation. Processes are not closed and volumes are not ejected automatically.

fileHash.desktopOnly: File SHA-256 requires the desktop native runtime.
fileHash.releaseUnconfirmed: Release of the file resource has not been confirmed. Try stopping again.
fileHash.jobIncomplete: The file task did not complete, so its result was discarded.
fileHash.hint: The native picker issues an identity-bound token. The native service reads 1 MiB chunks and revalidates the file before, during, and after reading; leaving the page stops the task, and no input is written to history.
fileHash.clipboardFailed: Could not write to the clipboard. Copy the digest manually.

keepAwake.desktopOnly: Keep-awake requires the desktop native runtime; the browser preview does not change power state.
keepAwake.invalidDuration: The keep-awake duration must be between 1 minute and 12 hours.
keepAwake.hint: Only a temporary system assertion is requested; power plans and simulated input are not changed. An independent deadline thread checks every 15 seconds and releases at expiry or cancellation. The current real-device evidence is limited to this macOS machine.

schedule.desktopOnly: Scheduled rules require the desktop native runtime; the browser preview does not save rules.
schedule.timeZoneUnavailable: The system did not provide an IANA time zone, so the rule cannot be previewed.
schedule.invalidOnce: Choose a valid date and time within the next 365 days.
schedule.noOccurrence: This rule has no next occurrence within the search horizon.
schedule.invalidDuration: The keep-awake duration must be between 1 minute and 12 hours.
schedule.hint: The native Cron searcher calculates the next occurrence before saving. Rules stay in CoreRobin's private data. At the scheduled time, only a reminder or a 1-minute to 12-hour keep-awake request is emitted; missed times are not replayed, and shell, cleanup, process termination, or keyboard actions are never executed.

processWatch.desktopOnly: Process exit watch requires the desktop native runtime.
processWatch.identityRequired: Enter the selected process PID and birth token; a same-name process cannot replace a stable identity.
processWatch.invalidDuration: The watch duration must be between 1 minute and 12 hours.
processWatch.birthTokenPlaceholder: Copy from process details; same-name substitution is rejected
processWatch.keepAwake: Add temporary keep-awake during the watch (released independently for low battery)
processWatch.hint: Only the user-selected ProcessKey is observed; termination permission is never requested. Up to 3 watches are allowed, with a default of 4 hours and a 12-hour limit. unknown is retried, PID reuse ends as identity_changed, and child processes, exit codes, or work success are not promised.

keyboardCleaning.title: Keyboard cleaning
keyboardCleaning.description: Temporarily block accidental input; cleaning starts only after the restricted helper explicitly confirms that the hook is effective.
keyboardCleaning.privacy: Key values are never recorded, keyboard content is never sent to the WebView, and the WebView receives no full permissions. Mouse activity, focus loss, host exit, sleep, revoked permission, or a missed helper heartbeat releases the hook.
keyboardCleaning.hardDeadline: Independent hard deadline: {{time}}; the helper must keep sending heartbeats or the active state is released.
keyboardCleaning.noBridge: The restricted helper bridge is not connected; this page stays unavailable and never simulates activation.
keyboardCleaning.footer: Platform capability must be provided by the host with least privilege; this page does not listen for DOM keyboard events. Real platform validation must use an isolated test environment.

networkAddresses.title: Local network addresses
networkAddresses.description: View addresses and ranges by interface. This tool does not probe the public internet, query DNS, test connectivity, or change network settings.
networkAddresses.privacy: IP addresses, IPv6 zones, MAC addresses, interface names, and pasted text stay in this page's memory. They are not written to history, diagnosis summaries, or URLs. Copying is user-initiated and sends network identifiers to the system clipboard.

copy.unsupported: This environment does not support copying. Select the text manually.
copy.success: {{label}} copied. It may contain IP, MAC, or interface identifiers and was written to the system clipboard only after your click.
copy.failure: Copy failed. The page does not read or retry the system clipboard.

live.noUniqueIp: The tool does not choose a supposedly “single true IP”.
live.empty: No interface addresses were returned. An empty result does not prove that the network is unavailable.

paste.placeholder: Paste macOS/BSD or Linux ifconfig text; parse only, never execute
paste.limits: Up to 256 KiB, 128 interfaces, and 64 addresses per interface. Non-contiguous IPv4 masks, invalid IPv4/IPv6 values, invalid zones, and conflicting prefixes are rejected. Unknown lines are counted on the relevant interface card.
paste.empty: No interfaces were recognized. Confirm that the pasted text is BSD/Linux ifconfig output.
